items.title: A finite central simple algebra tensored with its opposite is a matrix algebra
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file brauer.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that a finite central simple algebra tensored with its opposite algebra is a matrix algebra of size the degree of the algebra (statement lines 575-580). The proof is a complete argument: the tensor product with the opposite is simple by a named lemma (proof lines 582-584), the natural map into the endomorphism algebra of the algebra as a vector space is injective because its source is simple (proof lines 584-588), and a dimension count makes it an isomorphism, the target being a matrix algebra (proof lines 589-590). The non-formal content is the injectivity from simplicity and the dimension count. The claim is H2.
